thread:
samir: Quick FYI - kicking off a short least-priv/entitlement cleanup for the billing-encrypt keyring. We found an elevated admin role bound to a legacy ops group and a small window of missing KMS audit events overnight. Want a safe runbook before pruning. :mag:
leah.eng: thanks. which keyring and timeframe?
jamal-sec: billing-encrypt in us-west2. gap looks between 2026-03-21T22:10Z and 2026-03-21T22:40Z. not a huge window but enough to worry about one-off role changes.
oscar-sre: alert INFRA:KMS_PIPELINE_DROP triggered for forwarder-uswest2 at 22:12Z. might be transient. I'll check reingest and ack behavior.
samir: please assume telemetry may be incomplete until we confirm reingest. jamal, snapshot current admin principals and export KMS policy. immutable evidence only.
jamal-sec: on it. uploading to secure-bucket and will post SHA256. commands I ran:
```bash
# export key policy (gcp)
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy billing-encrypt --location=us-west2 --format=json > /tmp/billing-key-iam.json
# list principals with billing-admin role
gcloud projects get-iam-policy ${PROJECT} --flatten=bindings --filter='bindings.role:roles/redwood.billing.admin' --format=json > /tmp/billing-admins.json
```
evan-plat: I'll run the platform scanner for wildcard bindings across the org: `./tools/org-privscan --match '*billing*' --output /tmp/org-billing-wildcards.csv`
oscar-sre: quick log query I ran to look for KMS admin changes:
```bash
gcloud logging read "resource.type=kms_key AND protoPayload.methodName=SetIamPolicy" --freshness=48h --format=json > /tmp/kms-setpolicy.json
```
jamal-sec: snapshot uploaded to s3://redwood-audit/evidence/3955558000/snapshot.json sha256:9f3b2c... :white_check_mark:
auditbot: evidence archived and ticket SEC-2026-998 created. Link: https://rbw-issue/SEC-2026-998
samir: next steps proposal:
- oscar confirm whether forwarder reingested or messages lost (infra task INFRA-8290)
- jamal+evan produce candidate prune list with blast-radius and exact revert commands
- do not perform any ad-hoc prunes until we have immutable evidence and a rollback plan
- schedule a 20m canary prune window with 45m monitoring and emergency-grant ready
leah.eng: add a column in the CSV for "owner-contact" and "business-impact". any ownerless bindings should be tagged HOLD:partner-contact.
oscar-sre: infra note - forwarder restarted due to a config reload and reconnected; reingest attempted but ~35 messages were not acked. INFRA-8290 created to attempt safe backfill and assess payload integrity.
jamal-sec: running least-priv now. will include a short rationale and a revert snippet like:
```bash
# revert example
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding billing-encrypt --member='serviceAccount:svc-backup@partner.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/redwood.billing.admin'
```
evan-plat: found two broad bindings: legacy-ops@redwood and billing-devs@redwood with wildcard members. Flagging both; one shows no owner tag. Marked billing-devs as HOLD until owner is confirmed.
samir: good. if we must prune something with potential customer impact, use feature-flagged canary first and keep emergency-grant playbook handy (https://rbw-docs/internal/sec/emergency-grant.md). jamal, post the candidate CSV and a one-line risk summary by EOD.
jamal-sec: will do. ETA 4h. I'll upload CSV to the evidence path and include per-item revert commands and an estimated MTTD for rollback.
auditbot: ticket SEC-2026-998 updated with artifacts and playbook link.
oscar-sre: I'll post infra's backfill verdict here once INFRA-8290 completes. if we can safely backfill, that reduces uncertainty; if not, treat the gap as unknown and be conservative.
samir: thanks all. reminder: do not modify bindings outside the scheduled window and record every change in SEC-2026-998. escalate any ownerless production grants to me immediately.
